sources.snippet: Getting started Getting Started Enterprise AI model API gateway — one OpenAI-compatible key for 150+ models. Nebula API is an enterprise-grade AI model gateway built on the unified OpenAI API standard. One key gives you access to 150+ models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI, DeepSeek, Alibaba, Moonshot, Zhipu, ByteDance, MiniMax and more.
